response.sql: SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_rate_per_rental_day, COUNT(*) as film_count FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY original_language_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN original_language_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, film_count DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "At least 20.99" means replacement_cost >= 20.99 (not strictly greater than)
"Average of rental_rate divided by rental_duration" means AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration), computing the quotient per film before averaging, rather than AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration)
"Any missing counts last" means groups where original_language_id is NULL should appear after non-NULL groups in the sort order, preserving descending count order within each category
